transcript: Speaker A: छुट्टी पर जाते हैं तो पति बोलते हैं कि तुम बात मत करना, तुम्हारी इंग्लिश अनपढ़ वाली है। [When we go on vacation, my husband says, 'Don't talk, your English is like an uneducated person's.'] Speaker B: Don't worry, you can still learn English with me. Speaker A: पर कैसे सीखूं? टाइम ही नहीं मिलता है काम के बीच में। [But how do I learn? I don't get time between work.] Speaker B: I am your Seekho coach from English Seekho. Just practice with me for 10 minutes a day and see how to start speaking first-class English with confidence everywhere. You can even talk to me in Hindi and still learn English. Speaker A: सच में? इसके लिए मुझे क्या करना पड़ेगा? [Really? What do I have to do for this?] Speaker B: Just download the English Seekho app. इस ऐप पर आपको सीखो कोच मिलता है जो हर समय आपके लिए उपलब्ध रहता है और चाहे कितनी भी गलतियां करें, वह आपको कभी भी जज नहीं करेगा। इसलिए इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करें और सीखो कोच के साथ अंग्रेजी का अभ्यास करें। आखिरकार अभ्यास से ही अंग्रेजी सीखी जा सकती है और केवल रटने से कुछ नहीं होता। सीखो कोच के साथ लाखों लोगों ने अंग्रेजी सीखी है और अपनी जिंदगी में बदलाव लाया है। तो फिर आप किस बात का इंतजार कर रहे हैं? [Just download the English Seekho app. On this app, you get a Seekho coach who is available for you all the time, and no matter how many mistakes you make, they will never judge you. So download the English Seekho app and practice English with the Seekho coach. After all, English can only be learned through practice, and just memorizing doesn't do anything. Millions of people have learned English with the Seekho coach and brought a change in their lives. So what are you waiting for?] Speaker C: इंस्टॉल नाउ पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: Captions in Hindi and English showing the dialogue. End card: 'english seekho'. Disclaimer text in Hindi/English stating that the app is not affiliated with any government authority and results may vary.
summary: A woman shares her embarrassment over her husband criticizing her English skills. An AI avatar introduces the English Seekho app as a non-judgmental platform to practice English for 10 minutes a day. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app.
